The cost of chemical fertilizer is too high for me this season, so I will rely on the goat manure I have gathered to give the soil strength, but I will use improved cassava stems because they resist disease better than the local ones. I will buy a small amount of herbicide to spray for weeds since my children are not always around to help me hoe, but I do not need irrigation here because the rains are still good in our area. My family will do most of the planting and weeding work ourselves, though I will hire two young men from the neighboring village for a few days to help with the land clearing and heavy harvesting.
